"""Module for text decoding functions"""

import re
import zlib
from collections import namedtuple

def text_string(bstr):
    """Decode PDF text string according to encoding standards"""
    # Handle hexadecimal strings (starting with <)
    if bstr.startswith(b'<'):
        hex_str = bstr[1:-1]  # Remove < and >
        # Convert hex string to bytes
        hex_bytes = bytes.fromhex(hex_str.decode('ascii'))
        # Check for UTF-16BE encoding marker
        if hex_bytes.startswith(b'\xfe\xff'):
            return hex_bytes[2:].decode('utf-16be')
        else:
            # Assume PDFDocEncoded (Latin-1) but handle euro sign specifically
            # Euro sign (€) is encoded as 0xA0 in PDFDocEncoded
            latin1_bytes = hex_bytes.decode('latin1')
